name: Photon Marching
definition: A photon shooting method identical to ray marching with rays originating at lights. Instead of sampling in-scattered light, a photon is deposited at uniform intervals along the ray length, creating a 'discrete photon beam'.
summary: Photon Marching deposits energy at uniform intervals along light rays to create discrete photon beams, differing from standard tracing by distributing power across fixed steps rather than using random walks.
